visual_text: Before a medicine goes into food or drink: five checks
Suggested order, professional judgement. Check the law and guidance where you work.
Capacity for this decision assessed and written down
Best-interests decision recorded, with prescriber and family
Pharmacist advice on how each medicine can be given
Plan in the care record, with a review date

Norwegian nursing homes, older data: in one week, medicines were hidden in food or drink for 1 in 9 residents of regular units and 1 in 6 in dementia units; this was written in the record in 4 in 10 of those cases
Kirkevold and Engedal, BMJ 2005; Tan et al, BMJ Open 2022
alt_text: Checklist of five checks before a medicine is hidden in food or drink: is each medicine needed, capacity assessed, best-interests decision recorded, pharmacist advice, and a plan with a review date. A strip notes older Norwegian data: 1 in 9 and 1 in 6 residents, recorded in 4 in 10 cases.
